title: Bump mimid's crate-jmap pin: MemoryBackend's CallerCtx is now an Id, not ()
description:
Measured 2026-11-23, on a throwaway branch, because the VTC surface of
bead mimid-1wgh.114.2 needs jmap-vtc-types and mimid cannot see it.

WHERE MIMID IS: six manifests pin crate-jmap at
e4d206ea400b7a65001bd62e393d9efbca744db8, 18 dependency entries in all.
That is 288 commits behind, across the 0.6.2 release, and the
workspace's own changelog says "a minor bump may break the API".

WHAT THE BUMP COSTS, measured rather than guessed: `cargo check
--workspace --all-features` against 166aa504 gives 28 errors, all in
mimid-agent-jmap, and all ONE root cause:

  error[E0271]: type mismatch resolving
    `<MemoryBackend as JmapAccounts>::CallerCtx == ()`
    expected `()`, found `Id`

jmap-server's MemoryBackend now takes the caller as an `Id` rather than
`()`. mimid-agent-jmap passes `()` everywhere, because its clients are
authenticated before they reach the dispatcher and there was nothing to
carry.

THE SHAPE OF THE MIGRATION:
- AgentChat's `type CallerCtx = ()` becomes `Id` (one declaration).
- 34 `&()` call sites in mimid-agent-jmap/src.
- 18 `Dispatcher<()>` sites across mimid-agent-jmap's src and tests and
  mimid-agent's http.rs.
- mimid-agent's loopback HTTP layer must supply the caller's Id. It
  already authenticates the bearer credential before dispatch
  (docs/design/frontend-auth.md §3), so the value is in hand: the
  account's user URI. What needs deciding is whether the Id is the user
  URI or the account id, and the two are different strings in mimid.

NOT A BLOCKER FOR THE DEMO IF IT HAS TO WAIT: signalling and the media
secret are built and tested at the store level (bead mimid-1wgh.114.5),
and mimid's VtcOptions with ParlorVTC's relays is written. What the bump
unblocks is serving them over JMAP, which is what a stock client needs.

DO IT AS ITS OWN COMMIT, before any VtcBackend work, so that a
dependency upgrade and a feature are not tangled in one diff.
close_reason: Done: mimid commit e701a60e. CallerCtx is an Id, 19 pins moved, 34 call sites plus the trait signatures, twelve test files and the agent's HTTP dispatch. Full suite 215 suites / 2045 tests green.
